name: Wizzle Brassbolts
summary: Wizzle Brassbolts is a gnome engineer stationed alongside his fellow tinkerers out on the salt flats of Thousand Needles. Working with the gnomish racing team at the Mirage Raceway, he seeks durable local materials to reinforce their experimental rocket cars.

sections.title: Tinkering on the Salt Flats
sections.body: Out in the shimmering heat of the Shimmering Flats, the rivalry between gnomish and goblin engineering takes the form of high-speed rocket car races. Wizzle Brassbolts works as part of the gnomish raceway crew, striving to keep their vehicles intact against blistering speeds and abrasive salt. To bolster their machines, he recruits adventurers to hunt the local wildlife—such as the sturdy turtles wandering the basin—harvesting their hard shells to build new fuel tanks strong enough to hold his brother's corrosive new rocket fuel.

sections.title: Friends in Distant Places
sections.body: Wizzle maintains close ties with friends across the continents, including Pilot Longbeard, who sends couriers out with racing helmets for the brothers. With help like that, Wizzle keeps the gnomish team supplied despite their remote, inhospitable testing ground on the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: Where can I find Wizzle Brassbolts?
faq.answer: Wizzle Brassbolts is located at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats, in the southeastern reaches of Thousand Needles. He stands among the gnomish pit crew and their machinery.

faq.q: Why is Wizzle collecting turtle shells?
faq.answer: His brother is designing a new rocket fuel so strong it could eat right through the car's chassis. Wizzle uses the rock-hard shells of the tortoises on the Shimmering Flats to build new fuel tanks that can hold it.

The Brassbolts brothers are Wizzle and his brothers Fizzle and Rizzle, gnomish tinkerers who run the gnome rocket car team at the Mirage Raceway, racing against the goblins. Pilot Longbeard is a friend of theirs.

faq.q: Is Wizzle friendly to Horde players?
faq.answer: Yes. The Mirage Raceway is neutral ground, and Wizzle's own tasks, such as gathering hardened tortoise shells, are open to Horde and Alliance adventurers alike.

angles.text: Wizzle exemplifies the gnomish engineering philosophy: pushing high-velocity machines to their limits and relying on unusual structural reinforcements when metal sheets fail.
Gnomes visiting the Shimmering Flats will find in Wizzle a kindred spirit, stubbornly determined to defeat the reckless contraptions of the Steamwheedle goblins using superior craft.
